title: 応用化学専門実験・演習Ｂ３
subtitle: Applied Chemistry Major Lab/Exercises B3
teachers:
TANIDA Ikuhiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn the skills related to chemistry experimental operations, instrument handling, instrumental analysis, data analysis, and report preparation.
(2) Acquire the ability to evaluate results obtained from qualitative and quantitative experiments, and perform logical thinking.
(3) Learn theories and methods, acquire comprehension, and apply the knowledge.
advice:
In Applied Chemistry Major Lab/Exercises B3, biochemical experiments are conducted.

1. Experimental guidance, safety training, examinations
2. Measurement of reaction rates of proteolytic enzyme
3. Enzyme kinetics analysis
4. Analysis of proteins by SDS-PAGE
5. Treatment of plasmid DNA with ristriction enzyme

Bring a scientific calculator and scale.
If understanding the experiments and exercises is difficult, gain the understanding before next class through research, questions, or other methods.
books:
Textbooks: Ouyou Kagaku Senmon Jikken/enshu AB (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing)
Reference Books: Anzen Shishin (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing)

requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge of fundamental chemistry such as analytical chemistry, inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, physical chemistry, and biochemistry is needed to take this course.
If the progress of the experiment is delayed, course time will be extended until the experiment is completed, so keep some time free after the course on experiment days.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In Applied Chemistry Major Lab/Exercises B3, biochemical experiments are conducted.

1. Experimental guidance, safety training, examinations
2. Measurement of reaction rates of proteolytic enzyme
3. Enzyme kinetics analysis
4. Analysis of proteins by SDS-PAGE
5. Treatment of plasmid DNA with ristriction enzyme

Bring a scientific calculator and scale.
If understanding the experiments and exercises is difficult, gain the understanding before next class through research, questions, or other methods.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Knowledge of fundamental chemistry such as analytical chemistry, inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, physical chemistry, and biochemistry is needed to take this course.
If the progress of the experiment is delayed, course time will be extended until the experiment is completed, so keep some time free after the course on experiment days.
